research.scope: The current Zstandard implementation corroborates extending verified seed matches. The official Job API reference and direct-host tests distinguish the immediate job exposed through a null handle from a supervisor higher in a CTest launch tree.

measurement_scope.backing: Disposable indexed memory-image volumes on physical Windows. No drive mount or filesystem driver installation.
measurement_scope.inputs: Pinned distinct public source and documentation revisions, 20 files per cohort. Each comparison uses the same input fingerprint and independently reopens every file on CPU.
measurement_scope.reader_followup: Three rotating CPU and AMD repeats for both grouped reader revisions and both Zstandard 1.5.7 cohorts (24 runs), plus one raw CPU candidate control per cohort.
measurement_scope.match_refinement: Three alternating runs per cohort and codec profile of current CPU, AMD before hint extension, and AMD with extension (36 runs). Verified device members are the selected copy suggestions used in final member bodies.
measurement_scope.timing: Cold complete time covers discovery, maintenance and compaction with independent CPU verification. All maintenance is admitted under modeled idle credits. These workloads do not measure foreground interference, mounted throughput or sustained GPU acceleration.
measurement_scope.runtime: The unchanged, source-bound AMD worker, kernel and installed HIP artifacts were reused. The final WinFsp application build contains the refined writer and validation-budget changes.
